aggregateResidual.authorship: Existing public tools/build-granite-aggregate04.py, periodic Voronoi mineral volumes and finite-difference residual normal, no reference RGB
aggregateResidual.scope: Residual sub-grid slope/reflectance on existing mesh relief; no added stone geometry or reference imagery

materialTransfer.wetFilm: Authored world-space physical thin water film, IOR1.333, roughness .16, coat roughness .075, thresholded 3D coherent noise; original r4Wetness/r4Dampness attributes absent from official export. No painted shadow, source photograph or frame map.
materialTransfer.foliage: Energy-conserving thin diffuse transmission, 16% needles, 24% broad leaves/petals; complete alpha mask surrounds all lobes. Paper45%.
materialTransfer.skyAndReflector: Renderer-specific source sky and planar reflector excluded by official exporter; physical world and existing pond BSDF supply actual radiance/scene reflection.

importerProvenance.scope: Actual linked instance/full-affine importer and source vertex/instance attribute domains; no Scene01 sunset profile, scene02 sky helper, extra water plane or scene06 lighting fit is included.

affinePreservation.parentMatrices: Retained as full source object matrices. Source parent shear residual is checked separately below.
affinePreservation.linkedLocalMatrices: Geometry Nodes Object Info + Instance on Points with TRS decomposition only for matrices with normalized column shear residual <= 1e-7; retained translations, rotations and scales.

worldCoordinateConversion: One rigid +90degree X rotation of all source objects, instance parents, lights and the exact reference camera. Y-up becomes Z-up; no geometry/camera fit.

lightCalibration.sourceHemisphereLight: Replaced by shadowed physical sky GI; not added a second time as a nonphysical fill.
lightCalibration.calibrationScope: Source linear direct irradiance starting point retained; point power uses intensity*4pi. This is a documented radiometric proxy, not an absolute photometric measurement. No new studio lights, photographic shadows or environment geometry.

materialAttributeParity.linkedInstances: ShaderNodeAttribute Instancer with explicit POINT Store Named Attribute; exact source instance color once
materialAttributeParity.directAndBakedShear: Separate Geometry domain material variants; white direct fallback, source RGB for exact affine bake
materialAttributeParity.vertexColorMultiply: Only when source vertexColors flag is true; sourceColor POINT attribute preserved

physicalWater.geometry: Two actual exported pond surfaces only; no added water plane or backdrop
